tei:div.tei:p: de yang rtsa rgyud sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsang ba'i snying po'i 'grel pa kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer mchog gis ljags rtsom gnang ba zhig ste/ 'di'i ma dpe ni sngar rdzogs chen shing par gyi bu dpe zhig rtse po tā lar bzhugs pa tsam las/ mdo dbus khams kun tu btsal kyang dpe gzhan pa ma rnyed/ gzhung 'di'i rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis te/ spyi don lo rgyus kyi sgo nas khog dbub pa dang*/ bye brag gzhung don gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po brgyud tshul dngos dang*/ de la klan ka spangs pa gnyis yod pa'i dang po la/ rgyal ba dgongs rgyud dang*/ rig 'dzin brda rgyud/ gang zag rnar brgyud gsum yod pa'i nang nas gang zag rnar brgyud bshad pa'i skabs su/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du brgyud tshul mdor bsdus tsam song nas/ bod du rtsa rgyud gsang ba'i snying po snga phyir lan gsum 'gyur ba las/ phyi 'gyur paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen dang*/ lo tsā ba rma gnyags gnyis kyis 'gyur tshul 'chad pa'i mtshams nas tshang mi 'dug /'on kyang dpe nyid las gsal ba ltar na khyon shog grangs bdun cu don gsum pa de nyid la byon zhes bris pa ma zad/ gzhung gi tshig mtshams la'ang rdzogs tshig bris pa dang*/ mtshams thig gis bcad de mjug rdzogs pa'i rnam pa byas 'dug na yang*/ rtsa gzhung dngos kyi sa bcad la gzhig na gong zhus ltar/ spyi don lo rgyus kyi sgo nas khog dbub pa dang*/ bye brag gzhung don gyi sgo nas rtsa gzhung rgyas par bshad pa gnyis yod pa'i nang nas/ sa bcad dang po'i nang gses gang zag rnar brgyud kyi mjug yang ma tshang ba tsam du zad/ da lam dpe 'di las mngon pa ltar na/ dang po shing par du brko skabs nas mjug mi tshang ba'i rnam pa zhig 'dug pas/ rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos 'phro can du lus pa'am/ yang na shing par du 'god skabs dpe cha tshang zhig ma rnyed pa gang yin da lam gsal bshad zhu ma shes/

'di'i ma dpe ni rtse po tā la'i dpe mdzod khang gi rnying ma'i gsung 'bum gral/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer mchog gi gsung 'bum pod gnyis yod pa'i nang du bzhugs/ dpe 'di snga mo nas nga tshor rnyed son byung yang par rnying yin pa'i rkyen gyis yi ge mi gsal ba mang ba dang*/ cha mi tshang ba bcas kyi dpe gzhan pa zhig rnyed re byas te da sngon par skrun zhu rgyu ma byung*/ 'on kyang da lta'i char dpe gzhan pa yang rnyed pa'i re ba chen po med pa dang*/ 'di'i spyi don lo rgyus 'chad pa'i nang gses su/ rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po'i bstan don rgyud kyi dngos po bcu cha tshang zhig bstan yod pa dang*/ dpe rgyun mi nub pa sogs kyi ched du dmigs te par du bskrun pa yin/ 'dir ma dpe gsal po med pas thag ma chod pa 'ga' shas ni gug rtags nang du gsal bshad zhus te bzhag yod/ de min ni ma dpe sor bzhag gis zhu dag byas te bkram pa yin/ 'byung char mkhyen ldan klog pa po rnams kyis dpe gzhan pa rnyed son byung na dag zhus dang 'brel/ mjug mi tshang ba yang kha skong gnang thub min sogs thugs bzhag yod pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ da lam nga tsho'i mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di spyi tshogs thog 'grel spel byed skabs/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis mnyam las kyi sgo nas/ zhu dag dang*/ 'char 'god sogs rogs ram rgya chen gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang bcas/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/ 2008 lo'i zla 6 tshes 10 nyin la/ bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 3--PAGE 1-
